channel.title: Homeowners of Texas — Homeowner Watch
channel.description: Automatically refreshed Texas homeowner data and legislative activity.

item.title: HB 1014 Introduced
item.description: Relating to the disclosure of information regarding a transfer on death deed in certain residential real property transactions.

item.title: HB 1025 Introduced
item.description: Relating to the qualifications of a trustee authorized or appointed to exercise the power of sale of real property under a security instrument.

item.title: HB 1037 Introduced
item.description: Relating to the authority of a municipality to adopt, increase or decrease the rate of, or repeal an additional sales and use tax for property tax relief by ordinance or resolution of the governing body of the municipality.

item.title: HB 1053 Introduced
item.description: Relating to a memorandum of understanding between the Health and Human Services Commission and the Texas Department of Insurance to assist individuals disenrolled from Medicaid with applying for and obtaining other health benefits coverage.

item.title: SB 326 Introduced
item.description: Relating to the establishment of the Texas automobile insurance public option.
